description: 3D still water over a geodat hill (G 9 1, G 10 1, geo.dat) on 2 ranks, a refined box over the hill: the patches on both ranks cast the bed through the centres of the level-0 columns of both ranks (gbed0, two triangles per four centres, the exact distance in the band). The water stays at rest.
covers: cfd_amr::patch_bed in 3D (triangulated surface, dist2_tri), the columns of the other rank (gbed0)
